# Step - get_schema

`get_schema` · category: [Schema](../../traversal/step_reference.md#schema)

Returns the graph's stored schema as a map (unit when none is stored).

## Forms

```text
get_schema()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.get_schema() == ()   // true
```
